recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, vertically-oriented black and white documentary photograph framed by a wide, off-white textured border. The image depicts a crowded street scene with figures in raincoats and helmets, featuring a typewriter-style header at the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast central image against a neutral, textured negative space border
Mechanical, monospaced typography contrasting with organic, candid photography
Vertical central alignment of the image frame within a square canvas
coreInvariants: Typewriter-style display text at the top margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central rectangular image occupying approximately 60% of the total area, surrounded by a thick uniform border.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast figures in the center of the photograph.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left text, across to the top-right text, then down into the central photographic narrative.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial off-white border with a subtle paper grain texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/cream paper texture for the border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays within the central photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for shadows and asphalt reflections.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the bright border and the dark photographic elements.
paletteRestrictions: No pure white; use aged paper tones

letterConstructionRules: Slightly irregular ink-bleed effect typical of manual typewriters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Slightly raised baseline for certain characters to mimic mechanical misalignment

composition.position: Top margin, split between left and right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all text to maintain a utilitarian, documentary aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Thin inner keyline around the photograph
Subtle paper grain texture across the entire layout

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the clean but mechanical typewriter look.
Provides a more stylized, legible version of the aesthetic.
If a more distressed, 'dirty' typewriter look is desired.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square layout with a wide cream-colored textured paper border. In the center, place a vertical rectangular black and white photojournalism-style image of a 1970s street protest with people in raincoats and helmets on a wet street. Add a thin gray keyline around the photo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add monospaced typewriter-style text in the top margin. Place the title on the left and the artist name on the right, ensuring wide tracking and a dark charcoal ink-like color.

verificationChecks: Is the text monospaced and typewriter-like?
Is there a significant cream-colored border around the photo?
Is the central image high-contrast black and white?
Is the text placed in the top margin corners?

adjustableVariables: Contrast level of the central photograph
mustRedesign: Specific faces of people in the crowd
Any identifiable brand logos on clothing or helmets
Specific record label logos at the bottom

mustAchieve: Clear separation between image and border
avoid: Perfectly sharp vector edges on text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the image is vertical within a square frame
Check that text does not overlap the photograph
Verify the 'ink bleed' quality of the typography
Confirm the grayscale palette is consistent
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered, high-contrast B&W documentary photo with a wide, textured cream border and top-aligned typewriter typography for a classic folk-protest aesthetic.
